findings.passage: We don’t have foundational laws in place to protect citizens from gun violence— no laws requiring background checks or permits for handguns, no statewide concealed carry permit law, no extreme risk or “red flag” laws, and no laws requiring secure storage and preventing child access to guns and ammunition.
